dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Heh, it's what I do best. No one else even comes close.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: And what I really love to do to my opponents is raise the stakes to "if you lose, you join the Adventurers' Guild."

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: I think more people have joined the guild now due to losing to me than those who've actually volunteered. I kid you not!
